title: UI seed timeout is too short for a real network fetch
acceptance: testBrowsingControls passes on a clean install
The seeding wait accommodates a real fetch and extraction rather than assuming a fast one
No test is weakened to reach green
notes: Third of the four failures T-0045 found, and the only one that is genuinely a test problem rather than an app defect. On a clean install the suite seeds by saving a real URL, which fetches and extracts over the network; the 15s wait is not always enough, so testBrowsingControls fails before the library has anything in it. Depends on T-0053 only to avoid two agents in CairnUITests at once.

history.detail: attempt 1; the seed timeout failed my own verification run for T-0053
